description: This file defines a singleton object 'TvWebViewConfigurator' that provides configuration for WebView instances tailored for TV devices, setting various WebSettings and WebView properties to enhance compatibility and user experience on Android TV.

classes.name: TvWebViewConfigurator
classes.description: Object providing a method to configure WebView settings specifically for Android TV.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures a given WebView with TV-optimized settings such as enabling JavaScript, adjusting viewport, user agent, zoom controls, and theme for dark mode.
